title: Dogs in the park
scene: On Sunday Anna's family has a picnic near the pavilion in the park. They meet dogs of every kind - a bulldog, a beagle, a basset, a husky, a collie and a pit bull - see how dogs act by instinct, hear about a parasite from dirty water and clean up a dog's excrement.

words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
We had lunch in the park pavilion.
Our bulldog loves to sleep on the sofa.
Our beagle loves to smell everything on walks.
Our basset has very long ears and short legs.
Our husky has bright blue eyes and thick fur.
Our collie helps the farmer move the sheep.
My neighbor has a friendly pit bull.
Cats catch mice by instinct, not by learning.
The dog got a parasite from dirty water.
Please clean up your dog's excrement in the park.
Her chihuahua fits in her bag.
Our terrier barks at every car that drives past.
Our neighbor walks her white poodle every morning.

old_story: On Sunday, Anna's family has a [[picnic]] in the park. They sit at a table in the old [[pavilion]]. Soon a funny [[bulldog]] comes and looks at their sandwiches. Then a [[beagle]] and a sleepy [[basset]] follow it. Max arrives with his [[husky]] and his aunt's [[collie]]. A friendly [[pit bull]] plays with a ball near the trees. Max's aunt's dog moves the others together by [[instinct]], like sheep. A vet tells them about a [[parasite]] from dirty pond water. So Anna's dad fills a clean bowl for the dogs. Before they go home, Max cleans up his dog's [[excrement]]. Everyone says the park looks nicer than before.

title: Grandma's farm
scene: Anna and Max help on Grandma's farm. The farmer next door drives a tractor over many hectares, an old mule carries ten bushels of apples from the homestead, bees collect nectar, and Grandma talks about pesticides and a new hybrid tree.

words.ex: I buy eggs from a local farmer.
The farmer drove his tractor across the field.
The farm covers about fifty hectares.
The mule carried our bags up the mountain.
The farmer sold ten bushels of apples.
The family lived on a small homestead far from town.
Bees collect nectar from flowers to make honey.
Farmers spray pesticides on their crops.
This tree is a hybrid of two species.
How many acres of land does your family have?
Gas costs four dollars a gallon.
We sprayed insecticide on the roses in the garden.

old_story: Anna and Max spend Saturday on Grandma's farm. The [[farmer]] next door waves to them from his field. He drives his big [[tractor]] over forty [[hectares|hectare]] of wheat. Grandma's old [[mule]] is slow, but very strong. It carries ten [[bushels|bushel]] of apples from the [[homestead]] to the road. Behind the house, bees collect [[nectar]] from the flowers. Grandma never uses a [[pesticide]] in her garden. 'Bees are my friends,' she says. Her new tree is a [[hybrid]] of a pear and an apple. 'I want to taste the first fruit!' says Max.

title: Hiking in the Carpathians
scene: Anna and Max go hiking in the Carpathian Mountains. They camp near a cliff, use a compass to find the peak, feel the breeze from the canyon under old cedars, sit on granite rocks on a high plateau, look at the local flora and paddle a canoe across a lake, where they meet boy scouts who love scouting.

words.ex: We go hiking in the mountains every summer.
How much does summer camp cost?
The house stands on top of a high cliff.
We used a compass to find north.
We reached the peak of the mountain by noon.
A cool breeze came in from the sea.
We hiked down into the canyon.
A tall cedar grows in the corner of our yard.
Our new kitchen counters are made of granite.
The town sits on a high plateau.
The island has unique flora and fauna.
This watch has a quartz movement.
My son loves scouting because he goes camping with friends.
From the top, we saw a panorama of the city.
The island has rich flora and fauna.

old_story: In July, Anna and Max go [[hiking]] in the Carpathian Mountains. They stay at a small [[camp]] near a high [[cliff]]. Max uses a [[compass]] to find the path to the [[peak]]. On the way, a cool [[breeze]] comes up from the [[canyon]]. They rest under an old [[cedar]] on big [[granite]] rocks. Higher up, they walk across a wide, green [[plateau]]. Anna takes photos of the local [[flora]]: flowers, moss and berries. Then they paddle a [[canoe]] across a quiet mountain lake. On the shore, Max finds a shiny piece of [[quartz]]. Near the lake, they meet boy scouts who love [[scouting]]. Together they climb a hill and see a [[panorama]] of the mountains. Anna smiles, 'Let's come back next summer!'

title: National parks in America
scene: Max's cousin works as a park ranger in America. He shows them a grizzly, a coyote, a raccoon near the trash, bison, gophers and caribou, wild mustangs and an alligator in the swamp, warns them about cougars and makes a fire from hickory wood.

words.ex: Ask the park ranger where the trail starts.
A grizzly crossed the road in front of our car.
A coyote howled in the night.
A raccoon got into our trash last night.
A herd of bison crossed the road.
A gopher dug holes all over our lawn.
A herd of caribou crossed the road in front of us.
Wild mustangs run across the plains.
A cougar was seen near the hiking trail.
We used hickory wood for the barbecue.
A puma was seen near the hiking trail.

old_story: In August, Anna and Max visit Max's cousin, a park [[ranger]] in America. On the first morning, he shows them a [[grizzly]] fishing in a cold river. That night, a [[coyote]] howls somewhere near their cabin. In the morning, a [[raccoon]] is digging through their trash can. Later, they drive slowly while a herd of [[bison]] crosses the road. Max laughs at a small [[gopher]] that pops out of a hole in the grass. Then they fly north to Alaska and watch [[caribou]] walk across the tundra. In Nevada, a group of wild [[mustangs|mustang]] runs across the dry plains. Their last stop is a swamp in Florida, where an [[alligator]] lies in the sun. Every evening, Max's cousin warns them to stay on the trail because of [[cougars|cougar]]. On the last night, he makes a fire from [[hickory]] wood, and they roast corn. Anna says it was the best trip of her life.

title: A climate strike
scene: Anna joins a climate strike. Students talk about smog in the city, the ozone layer and melting icebergs, methane, carbon dioxide and fracking, eco solutions, and how a tornado or a tsunami can hit a whole region.

words.ex: The climate here is warm and dry.
The city is covered in smog today.
The ozone layer protects us from the sun.
The ship hit an iceberg and sank.
Cows produce a lot of methane every day.
Fracking gets gas out of rock deep under the ground.
We stayed at an eco hotel in the mountains.
A tornado hit the town last night.
The earthquake caused a huge tsunami.
It often rains in this region.
A strong cyclone hit the island last night.
A typhoon hit the coast last night.

old_story: On Friday, Anna joins a [[climate]] [[strike]] with other students in the park. Max's sign says, 'I want to see the sky, not [[smog]]!' A girl named Sofia talks about the [[ozone]] layer and why we need it. Another student shows a photo of a melting [[iceberg]] in the Arctic. A teacher explains that cows on big farms produce a lot of [[methane]]. Cars and factories also send carbon [[dioxide]] into the air. Some students ask questions about [[fracking]] and the water under the ground. Anna shares simple [[eco]] ideas, like bikes and reusable bags. A boy says a [[tornado]] once damaged his grandma's house. Sofia adds that one [[tsunami]] can hit towns along a whole coast. 'Bad weather can hurt a whole [[region]] at once,' she says. In the end, the group cleans the park together and plants three small trees.
